title: Define and test canceled mailbox wake semantics
outcome: Queued mailbox notification prompts can be canceled or cleared, but the durable-row and recovery behavior are undocumented and unpinned. Define whether cancellation suppresses a notification, requeues it, or requires acknowledgement, while preventing autonomous loops and silent stranding.
acceptance: Documentation states cancellation semantics; deterministic tests cover cancellation before dispatch, later ordinary dispatch or recovery, explicit read and acknowledge, and absence of duplicate autonomous turns.
